offset.description: Byte position to read from (default: where the last TaskOutput call for this task stopped)

block.description: Wait until the task finishes (or the timeout passes)

pattern.description: Regular expression; wait until a new output line matches it

timeout.description: How long to wait in milliseconds when block or pattern is set (default 30000, max 600000)

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
